verdicts.reason: A rebuilds the layout for landscape, with the can on the left and a strong headline/copy/CTA stack on the right. Its flaws: the NEW FLAVOR badge shrinks to an unreadable pill stranded below the CTA, away from the product; the headline breaks awkwardly into 'Chase the / Light'; the logo is undersized; and the bottom decorative circles look squashed and crowd the CTA. B is just the square design scaled down into the wide canvas. The headline is small, the subtitle and CTA text are tiny, the CTA sits almost on the bottom edge, there are large empty side areas, and the logo's sun mark looks squashed, so it does not adapt the hierarchy to the banner format.
